channel.title: on Industrial Manufacturing Knowledge Base
channel.description: Open industrial manufacturing knowledge base: aluminum & magnesium die casting, CNC machining, injection molding, tooling, materials, automotive manufacturing and supplier selection. 50+ engineering articles and reference tables.

item.title: 5-Axis CNC Machining: Kinematics, Uses and Trade-offs
item.description: 5-axis CNC machining explained: machine kinematics, 3+2 positional versus simultaneous milling, RTCP compensation, setup reduction and programming risk.

item.title: CNC Machining DFM: Design Rules That Cut Cost
item.description: CNC machining DFM rules that reduce cost: setup count, corner radii, pocket depth ratios, wall thickness limits, standard tooling and sensible tolerancing.

item.title: CNC Machining Fundamentals: Processes, Axes and Control
item.description: A technical introduction to CNC machining covering milling, turning, machine axes, CNC control architecture, toolpath generation and process capability.

item.title: CNC Milling vs CNC Turning: How to Choose the Process
item.description: How to choose between CNC milling and CNC turning based on part geometry, rotational symmetry, tolerance, cycle time, setup count and total machined cost.

item.title: CNC Surface Finish: Ra Values, Processes and Costs
item.description: CNC surface finish explained: typical Ra values by process, the turning finish formula, secondary finishing options and how finish specifications drive cost.

item.title: CNC Tolerances and GD&T: Practical Specification Guide
item.description: Practical guidance on CNC tolerances and GD&T: ISO 2768 general tolerances, achievable shop capability, datum reference frames, MMC and bonus tolerance.

item.title: Machining Aluminum Alloys: Parameters and Tooling
item.description: Machining aluminum alloys: cutting parameters for 6061, 7075, 2024 and cast A380, tool geometry, built-up edge control, coolant strategy and chip evacuation.

item.title: Machining Die Cast Components: Datums, Stock and Porosity
item.description: Machining die cast components: datum strategy on as-cast surfaces, machining stock allowances, subsurface porosity on sealing faces and silicon tool wear.

item.title: Speeds and Feeds: Cutting Parameter Calculation Guide
item.description: Calculate CNC speeds and feeds correctly: cutting speed, feed per tooth, table feed, material removal rate, chip thinning and depth of cut selection.

item.title: Workholding and Fixture Design for CNC Machining
item.description: Workholding and fixture design for CNC: the 3-2-1 locating principle, vises, soft jaws, vacuum chucks, clamping distortion and repeatability versus accuracy.
